Amount and currency are retained, but largest-fraction recipient selection differs from Core declared-order distribution. BCMath intermediates and float ranking were not executed or exhaustively verified. |

BCMath intermediates and float ranking were not executed or exhaustively verified. |

Other strategies, rational/zero-weight inputs and Brick Math internals are not claimed equivalent to Core. |

Scope: Signed equal splitting and ratio allocation were read. Equal splitting preserves signed residuals in the selected cases; an all-zero ratio list can return zero amounts for a nonzero source. This contrasts with a generic exact-value boundary and shows why a composing rounding policy must be expressly identified. Scope: Constructor and rounding/context paths only.
